exec: const expiry = Number(pm.environment.get("tokenExpiresAt") || 0);
const token  = pm.environment.get("accessToken");
// refresh 60s before expiry
if (!token || Date.now() > expiry - 60000) {
pm.sendRequest({
url: `${pm.environment.get("baseURL")}/oauth/issueToken`,
method: "POST",
header: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
body: { mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify({
client_id:     pm.environment.get("clientID"),
client_secret: pm.environment.get("clientSecret"),
grant_type:    pm.environment.get("grantType"),
username:      pm.environment.get("userName"),
password:      pm.environment.get("password")
}, (err, res) => {
if (err || res.code !== 200) throw new Error("Token request failed");
const body = res.json();
pm.environment.set("accessToken", body.access_token);
pm.environment.set("tokenExpiresAt", Date.now() + body.expires_in * 1000);
pm.test("Response time is within 10000ms", function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000);
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json");
pm.test("No server error", function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, "server error").to.be.below(500);
